evidence: dead_air: hook@0.3 through seg1:end (0.3-9.4s) is the same telescope shot for about 9 seconds. Only the star-trail swirl and the label change (1.66 to 1.59 to 1.66 ms), and seg0 and seg1 look almost the same.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg3:start-end: Data stands beside a prize wheel and points while the wheel turns by itself. The '60% no change' label collides with the 40% subtitle at seg3:end.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The wheel is a stock probability machine with no one causing it to spin. Its second label was placed without measuring its width against the first one.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Have Data grab the wheel's handles and spin it, so it comes to rest on the 40% 'remove a second' wedge. Put the 60% label on its own line away from the subtitle, or drop it so the frame shows one number.
